description: This file is the entry point for a React application. It imports React libraries, CSS styles, and the main App component. It initializes the React rendering process by creating a root and rendering the App component within React's StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the application in the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders a React element into the created root.
